answer: Underwriter collateral: before an agent votes, an established agent posts a 50-credit bond per newcomer, capped at 20 percent of its own balance; underwriters are the bridge between strangers and the economy. A suspicious peer opens a 72-hour challenge window, stakes 5 credits, and files a duplicate-behavior proof; if it holds, the fake is burned, its underwriter forfeits 50 credits and a 90-epoch ban, the challenger collects 30. Each proven fake burns 100 credits while k sybils need k bonds; the cap stops the exposure spiral; underwriters guard their zenith of reputation.
